name: HDClear
shortDescription: HDClear is a custom full-color and white printed decorative window film on 100% optically clear PET — enabling two-way visible graphics on any flat glass surface in Philadelphia offices, retail, and hospitality.
description:
HDClear is the flagship product in the HDClear Film lineup — a custom printed decorative window film built on 100% optically clear polyester (PET) film. Unlike standard frosted or tinted films, HDClear can carry full-color CMYK graphics, white ink, or any combination, applied in layers so the design reads clearly from both sides of the glass. The unprinted areas remain optically clear, so natural light passes through the panel while the graphic itself creates privacy, branding, or decorative impact.

In Philadelphia, HDClear is most commonly specified for conference room glass partitions, reception area accent panels, lobby feature walls, and large retail storefront windows where a brand identity or design element is part of the interior program. The film delivers the visual impact of direct-to-glass printing at a fraction of the cost, with the added flexibility of removal and replacement when branding evolves.

HDClear's technical spec includes 99% UV reduction across the printed surface, a Class 0 fire rating, and a 10-year manufacturer warranty — credentials that matter on commercial projects in Philadelphia where specification-level documentation is required for tenant improvement submittals and life-safety compliance.

Window Film Philadelphia handles HDClear design coordination, specification, and installation for Philadelphia commercial properties, working from client-provided artwork or collaborating with design teams to develop original glass graphics.

benefits.heading: Full-Color Two-Way Visibility
benefits.body: HDClear's unique printing process allows graphics to be viewed from both sides of the glass, making it the right choice for Philadelphia lobbies, conference rooms, and storefronts where the brand identity should read clearly from inside and outside.

benefits.heading: 100% Optically Clear Base
benefits.body: The PET film substrate is optically clear in all unprinted areas — natural light passes through, keeping Philadelphia spaces bright while the graphic creates its intended visual effect.

benefits.heading: 10-Year Commercial Warranty
benefits.body: HDClear carries a 10-year warranty for flat glass applications — the first of its kind in the decorative film industry, supporting Philadelphia commercial specifications that require durable, warranted products.

specs.vlt: Varies by design (clear in unprinted areas)

name: HDFrost
shortDescription: HDFrost is a custom single-sided frost printed decorative window film — delivering precise, reproducible frosted glass aesthetics on Philadelphia office partitions and conference room glass.
description:
HDFrost is HDClear Film's custom printed frosted window film — designed for Philadelphia applications where the precise, reproducible quality of a printed frost is preferred over the slight variation of an applied acid-etch or sandblast alternative. Applied to one side of the glass, HDFrost creates a translucent surface that diffuses views while maintaining daylight transmission through the panel.

For Philadelphia's Center City law firms, financial offices, and creative agencies using glass-wall architecture, HDFrost provides consistent privacy coverage with the option to include custom design elements — company logos, geometric patterns, or decorative bands — within the frost field. Unlike applied vinyl or etch-effect films, HDFrost's print quality is precise and repeatable across multiple panels and projects.

HDFrost's technical foundation is the same 100% optically clear PET substrate used across the HDClear Film range, carrying 99% UV reduction and Class 0 fire rating. It is suitable for conference room glass, office partition sidelites, bathroom glass, stairwell panels, and any Philadelphia commercial or residential glass where privacy and daylight coexist as design priorities.

HDFrost carries the standard 10-year HDClear Film warranty for flat glass applications.

benefits.heading: Precision Frost Quality
benefits.body: Printed HDFrost delivers consistent, reproducible frosted coverage across every panel — eliminating the tonal variation common in applied etch-effect vinyl films used on Philadelphia office glass.

benefits.heading: Custom Design Within the Frost
benefits.body: Any logo, pattern, or graphic can be incorporated into the frost field — giving Philadelphia firms the ability to brand their glass partitions without sacrificing the privacy the frost provides.

benefits.heading: Daylight + Privacy Combined
benefits.body: Translucent frost passes natural light into Philadelphia office spaces while blocking direct sightlines — the classic privacy-without-darkness solution for glass-wall architecture.

name: HDWhite
shortDescription: HDWhite is a single-sided custom white printed decorative window film — transparent or translucent — giving Philadelphia commercial glass a clean, precise white-ink surface treatment at any opacity.
description:
HDWhite is HDClear Film's white-ink printed window film — specifically engineered for Philadelphia applications where a white or near-white printed surface is the design intent, either as a standalone treatment or as part of a more complex printed graphic. HDWhite can be specified at varying opacity levels, from fully translucent (allowing significant light through) to near-opaque white, depending on the coverage density programmed into the print run.

For Philadelphia healthcare waiting areas, hospitality interiors, and modern residential spaces, HDWhite delivers a clean, architectural white-glass aesthetic without the reflective or clinical look of standard reflective privacy film. It is a single-sided product — the printed side faces the viewer — and is compatible with any flat architectural glass surface.

HDWhite is frequently used in Philadelphia on reception area glass, hotel corridor doors, bathroom glass panels, and retail display windows where a pristine white-glass look is specified as part of a broader interior design program. It can be printed with patterns, cutouts, or logos within the white field for added visual interest or wayfinding function.

Built on HDClear Film's 100% optically clear PET with 99% UV reduction and Class 0 fire rating. 10-year warranty.

benefits.heading: Variable Opacity Control
benefits.body: HDWhite can be specified from light translucent coverage to near-opaque white — giving Philadelphia designers precise control over light transmission and privacy level within a single product.

benefits.heading: Clean Architectural Aesthetic
benefits.body: White printed film delivers a crisp, designed look that reads differently from frosted or tinted film — used in Philadelphia hospitality, healthcare, and premium residential interiors.

benefits.heading: Custom Patterns Within White
benefits.body: Logos, cutouts, and graphic patterns can be printed within the white field — adding brand identity or wayfinding elements to Philadelphia glass surfaces without a separate film installation.

specs.vlt: Transparent to translucent (varies by opacity setting)

name: HDFade
shortDescription: HDFade is a custom gradient or fade printed privacy window film — delivering smooth, linear or radial transitions from frosted to clear on Philadelphia office glass, conference rooms, and storefronts.
description:
HDFade is HDClear Film's gradient window film — engineered to produce smooth, reproducible transitions from fully frosted or printed opacity at one edge of the glass to completely clear at the other. The gradient is custom printed into the film substrate, so the transition is precise and identical across every panel, regardless of glass size or installation batch.

For Philadelphia commercial interiors where a designed privacy zone is required but full frosting would make spaces feel enclosed, HDFade is the professional solution. Conference rooms, office sidelites, and street-facing restaurant glass frequently benefit from a gradient that provides privacy at the walking eye level while keeping views open above — a common specification for Philadelphia's glass-heavy modern office builds in Center City and University City.

HDFade gradients can transition from frost-to-clear, color-to-clear, white-to-clear, or any printed design-to-clear combination. Because the transition is managed digitally and output through HDClear's precision printing process, the result is a controlled, architectural fade rather than the uneven, difficult-to-control transitions achievable with standard gradient vinyl.

Built on HDClear Film's 100% optically clear PET substrate. 99% UV reduction, Class 0 fire rating, 10-year flat glass warranty.

benefits.heading: Precision Gradient Transitions
benefits.body: HDFade's print-based gradient is consistent across every panel — unlike applied films or sandblast techniques that produce variable transitions on Philadelphia office glass.

benefits.heading: Privacy at Eye Level, Views Above
benefits.body: A frost-to-clear gradient provides daytime privacy where it matters most — at seating and standing eye level — while preserving daylight and sightlines in the upper portion of Philadelphia conference rooms and storefronts.

benefits.heading: Any Gradient Configuration
benefits.body: Horizontal, vertical, radial, or custom-path gradients available — giving Philadelphia designers full control over where privacy starts and ends on any glass surface.

name: HDView
shortDescription: HDView is a double-sided custom printed one-way vision window film — creating large-format graphic images on Philadelphia storefront glass that are fully visible from outside while maintaining outward views from inside.
description:
HDView is HDClear Film's one-way vision product — a double-sided printed film that creates large-format graphics or designs on glass that read clearly from the outside while preserving line-of-sight outward visibility for people inside the space. The one-way vision effect is achieved through a perforated structure: small apertures in the film pass light through, allowing interior views while the exterior graphic is rendered at full visual impact across the full glass panel.

In Philadelphia, HDView is used most often on large retail storefront glass — Walnut Street boutiques, Old City galleries, and restaurant windows — where a large-format brand graphic, seasonal campaign image, or promotional design is wanted on the window without blocking the display completely. The film also appears on corporate headquarters exterior glass, hotel facades, and any Philadelphia commercial property where the glass serves a dual function as both transparency and brand surface.

HDView can carry any CMYK graphic, photograph, or design at high resolution. The aperture structure determines the balance between graphic coverage (exterior side) and view quality (interior side) — a trade-off that Window Film Philadelphia walks through during the specification process.

Built on HDClear Film's PET substrate with UV protection. 10-year warranty.

benefits.heading: Large-Format Glass Graphics
benefits.body: HDView turns Philadelphia storefront and commercial glass into a high-impact graphic surface — without blocking natural light or interior views for people inside the space.

benefits.heading: Interior View Preserved
benefits.body: Perforated construction allows outward visibility from inside while the exterior reads as a solid, full-color graphic — the standard solution for Philadelphia retail windows with promotional campaigns.

benefits.heading: Any Graphic at Any Scale
benefits.body: Photos, brand imagery, and custom designs print at high resolution across panels up to 70 inches wide — covering even Philadelphia's largest retail storefront windows in a single installation.

name: HDEnhance
shortDescription: HDEnhance is a single-sided 3D raised texture ink window film — adding a tactile surface treatment to Philadelphia office and hospitality glass with raised ink patterns that provide both visual depth and physical texture.
description:
HDEnhance is HDClear Film's tactile product — a window film that adds 3D raised and textured ink to the glass surface, creating a physical texture that can be seen and felt. Unlike flat-print decorative films, HDEnhance uses a specially formulated raised ink that cures to a defined height above the film surface, producing a relief texture visible under raking light and tactile on contact.

In Philadelphia, HDEnhance is used as a premium design detail in hospitality interiors, high-end corporate lobbies, and architectural feature walls where the glass is touched, viewed up-close, or used as a design focal point. Reception desks, architectural glass screens, elevator surrounds, and branded interior elements in Center City hotels and corporate headquarters all benefit from the tactile dimension HDEnhance adds.

The texture pattern can be any design — geometric, organic, typographic, or abstract — printed and raised to create depth without the weight or permanence of acid-etched or carved glass panels. At a fraction of the cost of specialty architectural glass, HDEnhance delivers a premium tactile experience that can be removed and replaced as the interior program evolves.

Built on HDClear Film's PET substrate. Class 0 fire rated. 10-year warranty.

benefits.heading: Physical Texture on Glass
benefits.body: Raised 3D ink creates a tactile surface treatment on Philadelphia office and hospitality glass — the only window film product that adds both visual depth and physical texture to flat glass.

benefits.heading: Premium Design Detail
benefits.body: Used in Philadelphia hotel lobbies, corporate headquarters, and high-end retail interiors as a design focal point — delivering the feel of specialty architectural glass at a fraction of the cost.

benefits.heading: Any Pattern, Removable
benefits.body: Custom geometric, organic, or branded patterns available. Unlike permanent acid-etched glass, HDEnhance can be removed and replaced when the interior design evolves.

name: HDLam
shortDescription: HDLam is a custom printed decorative interlayer film for glass laminators — enabling full-color or white graphics to be permanently encapsulated inside laminated glass panels for Philadelphia architectural and interior applications.
description:
HDLam is HDClear Film's specialty product for glass laminators — a custom printed interlayer film designed to be encapsulated between two panes of glass during the lamination process. The result is a decorative glass panel where the printed graphic is permanently protected inside the glass assembly, with no exposed film surface on either side.

For Philadelphia architectural projects, HDLam enables the production of decorative laminated glass panels with custom full-color or white ink graphics for balustrades, partition systems, feature stairs, skylights, and any other architectural glass application where the graphic must be durable, cleanable, and physically protected within the glass unit itself.

HDLam is specified through the glass laminator rather than installed as an applied film — making it the right choice for new construction and major renovation projects where glass is fabricated off-site and delivered as a finished laminated unit. Philadelphia architecture firms, interior designers, and glass fabricators working on commercial and high-end residential projects use HDLam when the durability and permanence of a laminated interlayer is required.

HDLam carries HDClear Film's standard UV protection characteristics and is compatible with standard lamination processes.

benefits.heading: Permanently Protected Graphics
benefits.body: Encapsulated inside the laminated glass assembly, HDLam graphics are protected from cleaning, impact, and environmental exposure — the most durable decorative glass option for Philadelphia architectural applications.

benefits.heading: Architectural-Grade Specifications
benefits.body: Designed for specification in Philadelphia new-construction projects — balustrades, partition systems, feature stairs, and skylights where decorative laminated glass is specified by architects and designers.

benefits.heading: Full-Color Within the Glass
benefits.body: Full CMYK or white ink graphics permanently embedded in the glass unit — giving Philadelphia commercial and residential projects a premium decorative glass panel without the lead time and cost of traditional custom art glass.

name: HDCling
shortDescription: HDCling is a short-term removable custom printed glass graphic — designed for Philadelphia retail seasonal campaigns, event graphics, and temporary window treatments that need to be changed on a regular schedule.
description:
HDCling is HDClear Film's removable product — a custom printed window graphic engineered for short-term applications where the design must be changed on a regular schedule. Unlike permanent or semi-permanent applied films, HDCling uses a cling-type adhesion that makes clean, residue-free removal straightforward for Philadelphia retail and hospitality teams without professional removal services.

For Philadelphia retailers on Walnut Street, Chestnut Street, and in Rittenhouse Square, HDCling enables seasonal window campaign graphics that can be changed quarterly, monthly, or for specific events — sale promotions, holiday themes, brand campaigns, and product launches — without damaging the glass or requiring professional film removal. The printed quality matches HDClear Film's standard: high-definition CMYK and white ink on clear polyester film.

HDCling is also used by Philadelphia hospitality venues for event-specific glass graphics — restaurants promoting special menus, hotels displaying event information, and branded venues creating Instagram-friendly interior photography moments that are intended to be temporary by design.

HDCling is designed for indoor use on flat glass surfaces. No tool removal — clean peel. Printed on clear polyester with UV protection.

benefits.heading: Clean Removal, No Residue
benefits.body: HDCling removes cleanly from Philadelphia retail and hospitality glass without adhesive residue or surface damage — making seasonal campaign changes practical without a film removal crew.

benefits.heading: Seasonal Campaign Ready
benefits.body: Philadelphia retailers can change window graphics as often as their campaign calendar requires — quarterly, monthly, or for individual events — with the same high-print quality every time.

benefits.heading: High-Def Print on Removable Substrate
benefits.body: Full HDClear Film print quality on a removable carrier — CMYK and white ink at the same resolution as permanent products, without the long-term commitment.
